lines.text: The applicable welcome bonus rate is dependent on your selected premium term and premium amount. The welcome
bonus is calculated as a percentage of the premium paid for the first year of the policy.
The loyalty bonus is equivalent to 1% of the prevailing NAV after deduction of any top-up premium(s) and recurrent single
premium(s), net of the premium charge, in the preceding 24 calendar months. For avoidance of doubt, if the NAV after
deduction is negative, no loyalty bonus will be payable.
A surrender penalty period applies to each premium term, please refer to the product summary for details.
For premium term of 5 years, surrender penalty is applicable for the first 8 premium years.
For premium term of 10 years, surrender penalty is applicable for the first 10 premium years.
For premium term of 15 years, surrender penalty is applicable for the first 15 premium years.
Product administration fee is payable for the first 24 premium years by cancellation of units from your policy on a monthly
basis. Please refer to the product summary for details.
The minimum recurrent single premium is $500 per transaction, in your policy currency. The maximum recurrent single
premium is capped at 25% of the prevailing premium. The minimum top-up premium is $500, in your policy currency. A 3%
premium charge applies for top-up and recurrent single premium. Please refer to the product summary for details.
Please refer to the product summary for details.
For a partial withdrawal, the minimum amount you may withdraw is $250. Total NAV of the remaining units in the policy must
be at least $1,000 based on their unit price on the date we receive the request for partial withdrawal. Terms and conditions
apply, please refer to the product summary for details.
We will recover your welcome bonus when you reduce your premium. You can only apply to increase the premium after the
issue date if you had previously reduced the premium with our consent. The increased premium cannot be greater than the
original premium amount you paid. Please refer to the product summary for details.
During premium holiday, the product administration fee will continue to be deducted accordingly. Please refer to the product

HSBC Life
Goal Builder II
Connecting you to your future wealth
1 of 18

HSBC Life Goal Builder II is precisely crafted
to ignite the visionary, the planner, and the
achiever in you.
This investment-linked plan (ILP) combines lifelong protection with the flexibility to grow
your wealth while safeguarding your loved ones’ financial future. With access to a broad
range of close to 80 world-class ILP sub-funds, attractive bonuses, and the ability to
tailor your portfolio as your needs evolve, it empowers you to build a strong connection
toward your future wealth filled with possibilities.
Whether you’re funding your child’s education, preparing for a comfortable retirement,
or seeking to grow your wealth, let us help you build your bridge as you journey ahead
to meet your goals.
